source_note: Human-verified privacy contacts, keyed by the platform name exactly as it appears in the unified site registry. This file ships EMPTY of platform entries on purpose. utils/privacy_contacts.py resolves anything absent here at runtime from the platform's own security.txt (RFC 9116) or privacy policy, and reports 'unresolved' when neither exists. A guessed address (privacy@<domain>) would be indistinguishable in the output from a verified one, so a user would start a statutory clock against a mailbox that may never have existed -- which is why guessing is not one of the resolution steps.

emails: list of verified addresses, strongest first
urls: list of verified rights-request or opt-out URLs
entry_schema.verified: true only when a human confirmed the contact works
